Subject: Employee calendar fails with HTTP 500 after selecting a month

1. Sign in to the HR portal on desktop.
2. Open Employees > Employee Calendar.
3. Switch from October to September.

Expected: calendar days and absence markers load for September.
Actual: blank calendar and '500 Internal Server Error'; sometimes the spinner just stays there.

Bug report - Absence request page freezing

1) Open ESS web > Absences > New request.
2) Choose next Wednesday as the start date.
3) Set duration to Half day and select Afternoon.
4) Open the absence code dropdown.
5) Pick a code and click Continue.

Expected result: the next screen should show the request summary.
Actual result: screen goes white, no confirmation, no visible error. If I go back, there is no request in the list.
